name: Nature & hiking
title: Nature and hiking holidays
intro: Mountains, lakes, waterfalls and wildlife. Here's where to go for a nature or hiking holiday, from easy walks to proper adventures, and when to go.

faqs.question: Where is good for walking holidays in Europe?
faqs.answer: Annecy, Interlaken, Lake Garda, the Azores, Madeira and Lofoten all have walks for every level, from flat lakeside paths to mountain trails.

faqs.question: Where can we see wildlife on holiday?
faqs.answer: The Galápagos Islands, the Maasai Mara, Borneo, Costa Rica and Namibia are some of the best places in the world to see animals in the wild.

faqs.question: When is the best time for a hiking holiday?
faqs.answer: Summer suits the mountains of Europe and North America, from June to September. Hot places like Jordan and the Grand Canyon are better in spring and autumn.
